description: This file defines Express.js routes for handling invoice-related API endpoints, including fetching and creating invoices, with authorization middleware applied.

methods.name: GET /api/invoices
methods.description: Fetches a sorted list of all invoices, accessible only to users with SuperAdmin or ServiceCenterAdmin roles.

methods.name: POST /api/invoices
methods.description: Creates a new invoice with provided data, accessible only to users with SuperAdmin or ServiceCenterAdmin roles.
